tasks.Calculate_Games_Won_Change_2009_to_2010: Calculate the rate of change in games won between 2009 and 2010.
tasks.Interpret_Rate_of_Change: Interpret the calculated rate of change.

answer: The rate of change in games won between 2009 and 2010 is -13 games per year. This means that Joseph's soccer team lost 13 games from 2009 to 2010.
